summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader@0.8.9 declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts and chmod+x's the binary, and then uses that runtime to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's machine. `math_init.js` is a 727KB, single-line, minified file carrying a `@bun-cjs` banner and string-array-with-shift obfuscation (a rotator function `WV8StW` cycling a large mixed numeric/string array `n7gIxM`); its behavior is not visible to normal Node inspection. The package's advertised purpose is a small webpack loader wrapper around typed-css-modules — the shipped `index.js` is a thin wrapper unrelated to the Bun download or the obfuscated payload, and no legitimate webpack loader requires an alternate runtime, network I/O at install time, or a 727KB opaque blob. The `@ornikar` scope also mismatches the package's declared repository, which points to the unrelated upstream `olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader`, indicating scope-squatting used to deliver the dropper rather than a maintenance fork. `npm install` of this version fetches an alternate runtime and executes attacker-supplied obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
